text: Equip weapons, armor and artefacts in your inventory with ###input.INPUT_INVENTORY_ITEM_SELECT###.
zh: 按###input.INPUT_INVENTORY_ITEM_SELECT###装备物品栏中的武器、防具和神器。

text: Equip weapons, armor and artefacts in your inventory with ###input.INPUT_INVENTORY_ITEM_SELECT### or ###input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT###.
zh: 按###input.INPUT_INVENTORY_ITEM_SELECT###或###input.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT###装备物品栏中的武器、防具和神器。

text: Use ###input.INPUT_INVENTORY_ITEM_DROP### to drop items that aren't equipped or needed for quests.
zh: 按###input.INPUT_INVENTORY_ITEM_DROP###可丢弃未装备且任务不需要的物品。
